title: 3. Access / Insert / Delete — Big-O
markdown:
### 3. Access / Insert / Delete — Big-O

| Operation | Array | Linked List |
|---|---|---|
| Index Access | **O(1)** | O(n) |
| Value Search（无序） | O(n) | O(n) |
| Insert / Delete（中间） | O(n) | **O(1)**\* |

\* 已知操作位置 → O(1)；需 Traversal → O(n)

- **Array**：Index → 直接计算 Memory Address
- **Linked List**：Counter 记录逻辑 Index → Sequential Traversal → O(n)
- **Insert / Delete**：Array 通常移动 Elements；Linked List 修改 References

**Linked List — Insert / Delete（Singly vs Doubly）**

| Operation | Singly（next） | Doubly（prev + next） |
|---|---|---|
| **Structure** | A → B → C | A ⇄ B ⇄ C |
| **Insert N after A** | `N.next = B` | `N.prev = A` |
|  | `A.next = N` | `N.next = B` |
|  |  | `A.next = N` |
|  |  | `B.prev = N` |
| **Insert Time** | O(1)（仅知 A） | O(1)（仅知 A） |
| **Delete B** | `A.next = C` | `B.prev.next = B.next` |
|  |  | `B.next.prev = B.prev` |
| **Delete Time** | 仅知 A → O(1) | 仅知 B → O(1) |
|  | 仅知 B → O(n) |  |

*前提：中间位置（非 Head / Tail）*
